verdict.rationale: Skyvern ships a Python/TypeScript/REST SDK and self-hosted deployment on your own infrastructure with your own LLM keys, enabling headless/CI use, and this is corroborated by a runtime probe showing the OSS package installs from PyPI and exposes a CLI. Docs also describe code-first, no-UI 'Browser Automation' workflows suitable for scripted/CI invocation. Missing for 10: no explicit CI pipeline example/docs (e.g., GitHub Actions integration) or independent report of someone running Skyvern in a CI pipeline.
